methodology.mode: static source and documentation only; no lab code imported, installed, started or exploited; Sentinel-Zero not read, changed, or run
methodology.scope_policy: Exact supplied identities. os.popen, fs.createReadStream/createWriteStream, fs.promises.*, node-serialize, mathjs.eval and PIL.ImageMath.eval are not silently treated as supported identities. SSRF is planned, including requests.get, fetch and needle.get, whose actual identities are preserved. JSON parsing is explicitly low signal.
methodology.counting_unit: Maintainer catalog item/scenario, not unique CWE or sink site. Shared sinks, broad grouped catalog entries, and non-vulnerability Juice Shop tasks prevent interpretation as independent bug count. Main table is catalog-unit coverage, not an exact empirical real-vulnerability fraction.
methodology.readiness: PARTIAL: source localization is incomplete for out-of-scope catalog units; documentation claims and missing-control exercises are not converted into invented sinks. Use located:true rows for source-location scoring only.
methodology.scope_share_limit: Reported in_scope/all_documented_catalog_units is descriptive supported-call visibility; unresolved locations and challenge tasks mean it is not a certified exact share of real exploitable vulnerabilities.
methodology.negative_controls: Six named-property controls: three live secure modes/endpoints, one live bounded-loop control, two official SQL teaching snippets. Only one is a supported execution sink; insufficient for a meaningful supported-sink false-positive rate.
